from __future__ import annotations
import hashlib, json, sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT=Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
if str(ROOT) not in sys.path:
    sys.path.insert(0,str(ROOT))

from control.model_execution.direct_sol_chat import validate_request, validate_result
from control.model_execution.direct_sol_record import normalized_run_files

TASK="A2Z-V4-SOL-PROPOSAL-DIRECT-20261007-R4P2"
REQ=ROOT/"control/model_execution/direct_requests"/(TASK+".json")
RES=ROOT/"control/model_execution/direct_results"/(TASK+".json")
OUT=ROOT/"control/dev_checks/r4p2_direct_runtime_stage_n1e1"
RUN_NAME=TASK+"-direct-r4p2"

request=json.loads(REQ.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
result=json.loads(RES.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
validate_request(request)
validate_result(request,result)

proposal=json.loads(result["final"])
assert proposal["candidate_id"]=="AUTO-DISCOVERY-54d13314c7879b58e46d"
assert proposal["proposal_version"]==4
assert proposal["qualification_id"]=="FULL-A2Z-LIVE-20261004-V4"
assert proposal["scientific_status"]=="NO_PROVEN_EDGE"
assert proposal["safety"]=={"live_trading":False,"paid_actions":False,"wallet_actions":False}
assert {x["name"] for x in proposal["intended_artifacts"]["artifacts"]}=={
    "complement_checker_v4.py","test_complement_checker_v4.py","qualification_stream_v4.json"
}

files=normalized_run_files(request,result)
run=OUT/"run"
run.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
for name,text in files.items():
    (run/name).write_text(text,encoding="utf-8")

def sha(path: Path)->str:
    return hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()

envelope={
 "schema":"PVA_GOVERNED_MODEL_COMPLETION_V1",
 "task_id":TASK,
 "phase":request["phase"],
 "model":"gpt-5.6-sol",
 "model_policy":"SOL_EXACT",
 "execution_layer":"DIRECT_SOL_CHAT",
 "route_task_id":request["delivery_route_task_id"],
 "campaign_id":request["campaign_id"],
 "input_sha256":request["input_sha256"],
 "checkpoint":"models/runs/"+RUN_NAME,
 "completion_sha256":sha(run/"COMPLETE.json"),
 "worker_sha256":sha(run/"WORKER.json"),
 "request_sha256":sha(REQ),
 "direct_result_sha256":sha(RES),
 "final":result["final"],
}
(OUT/"model_result.json").write_text(
    json.dumps(envelope,indent=2,sort_keys=True,ensure_ascii=False)+"\n",
    encoding="utf-8",
)
print("DIRECT_SOL_R4P2_STAGE=PASS")
print("ROUTE="+request["delivery_route_task_id"])
print("COMPLETION_SHA256="+envelope["completion_sha256"])
print("WORKER_SHA256="+envelope["worker_sha256"])
